ptah.run/mysql/table.constraint: The options a declaration states for a table: its storage engine, the first value of its auto-increment column and its default character set. An option left out is the server's to decide. The options apply when the table is created.
The default character set a read found the table holding, from its collation. The engine and the next auto-increment value are not read.

canonicalization: Keys are written in the order above, and an option left out is omitted. Names keep the spelling they were written in.
